cases.name: vp9_decode
cases.error: MissingMediaDecoderError("Cannot decode video: this video (codec 'vp9') has no decoder in this image: shipped images decode only H.264/H.265 (in hardware, via NVDEC), and the 'cv2' they ship is built without a video backend. Re-encode the input to H.264/H.265, or replace the shipped build with the binary wheel of the same version: `pip install --no-deps --force-reinstall --only-binary opencv-python-headless 'opencv-python-headless==5.0.0.93'` (or `python -m dynamo.common.utils.install_media_decoders vllm`). (decoder reported: <class 'cv2.VideoCapture'> returned a result with an exception set)")
